name: tvijo-dshrem
description: Managed coding and bounded reviews for shared projects with a per-task spending cap. Provider API credentials remain on the service.

commands.title: Open coding task and preview diffs
Add file to my knowledge base

tvijo.pack.markdownDescription: Choose a server skill pack by ID. Empty selects automatically from root project markers, then engineer when available. Use `none` (No pack) to disable pack instructions and automatic suggestions. Pack instructions are fetched after sign-in and are never stored in chat history. Explicit model choices take priority.

tvijo.service.markdownDescription: Selects the managed shared-project service. Use when choosing a shared workflow; the server reserves an immutable quote. Shared projects use this service instead of chat model/mode.

tvijo.model.markdownDescription: Requests a model for ordinary chat and Quick Edit. Use to choose a route; unavailable routes are refused. Shared-project chat uses service quotes instead. Local Agent/Plan uses agentModel.
enumDescriptions: Default coding route for ordinary chat and Quick Edit.
Server chooses an activated route for the request.
Request the ds41f route; the server verifies availability.
Request the glm53f route; the server verifies availability.
Request the Devstral route; the server verifies availability.
Request the Haiku route; the server verifies availability.
Request the GPT-6.1 Sol service route. This does not use your Codex subscription.
Request the Luna service route; unavailable routes are refused.

tvijo.agentMode.markdownDescription: Changes ordinary chat routing: single, auto or council. Use council for a bounded review; it shares one service task ceiling. Local Agent/Plan always requests single mode per step.
enumDescriptions: One model per ordinary chat answer.
Deterministic service routing for ordinary chat.
DeepSeek and GLM collaboration for chat under one task ceiling. Not the local Agent loop.

tvijo.reasoningMethod.markdownDescription: Selects the requested reasoning workflow for chat, Quick Edit and Agent steps. Use to choose evidence-first, plan-check or peer-review. This is no quality or savings guarantee.
enumDescriptions: Ask for evidence from supplied context.
Ask for a plan and a check against evidence.
Ask for review of the draft; does not itself activate a council.

tvijo.workspaceContext.markdownDescription: Controls bounded project context. Use off for less sharing or on for project questions. Ask remembers the consent choice; reselect Ask in the chat context control to reset it. Preview before sending; exclusions are not a guarantee against all sensitive text.
enumDescriptions: Ask once and remember consent. Reselect Ask from the chat context menu to reset.
Include a bounded project summary with each supported request.
Do not add automatic project context. Explicit attachments are still sent.

tvijo.workspaceContextMaxBytes.markdownDescription: Limits the generated project-context block in bytes. Reduce it when context is too large. It does not cap attachments or the entire conversation; Agent/Plan and Quick Edit each use a separate 16000-byte project-context limit.

tvijo.autoApply.markdownDescription: Skips the final Quick Edit apply confirmation after the diff is opened. Enable only for reviewed workflows. Edits change an unsaved editor buffer; this does not save files or control Agent edits.

tvijo.agentModel.markdownDescription: Requests one model for each local Agent or Plan step. Use a route that reliably returns tool JSON. Each step is a separate service task in single mode, regardless of chat model/agentMode; unavailable routes are refused.
enumDescriptions: Request the ds41f route; the server verifies availability.
Request the glm53f route; the server verifies availability.
Request the Devstral route; the server verifies availability.
Default coding route for ordinary chat and Quick Edit.
Server chooses an activated route for the request.
Request the Haiku route; the server verifies availability.
Request the GPT-6.1 Sol service route. This does not use your Codex subscription.
Request the Luna service route; unavailable routes are refused.

tvijo.agentMaxSteps.markdownDescription: Caps tool steps in one local Agent/Plan loop, including JSON repair turns (default 12, maximum 30). At the limit, one additional metered turn without tools summarizes the collected evidence within the same session budget.

tvijo.agentBudgetUsd.markdownDescription: Sets the local Agent/Plan loop budget in USD; the host checks remaining budget before another step and passes a bounded task cap. Separate service per-task ceilings still apply. This is neither account credit nor a credit purchase.

tvijo.agentAutoRun.markdownDescription: Skips per-command approval only for local Agent commands matching the allowlist. Use for trusted build/test/lint routines. Destructive commands remain blocked; Plan refuses all commands.

tvijo.agentAutoApply.markdownDescription: Skips per-file approval for local Agent edits. Use when you can review opened diffs. Edits remain unsaved editor buffers; Plan refuses writes even when enabled.

tvijo.telegram.enabled.markdownDescription: Enables the owner-only Telegram connector on this extension host after bot configuration. Use only on a host that should run your bot. It requires a separately stored bot token and owner ID.

tvijo.telegram.ownerId.markdownDescription: Legacy native value, not the active bot owner. Use Configure Telegram bot to set the owner for the signed-in account. The active owner is saved per account; changing this field alone does not transfer control. Bot tokens belong in SecretStorage.
tvijo.telegram.ownerId.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use **Tvijo: Configure Telegram bot** to change the account-local owner.

tvijo.ocrLanguages.markdownDescription: Selects installed Tesseract languages for local PNG/JPG OCR. Use eng+rus for English/Russian screenshots when installed. Only extracted text is sent as context; the model does not see image layout.

tvijo.apiBase.markdownDescription: Changes the service API endpoint. Use only for a trusted deployment; HTTPS is required except localhost development. Changing it switches account scope. Do not put credentials or tokens in this URL.

tvijo.telegram.allowedServices.markdownDescription: Allows exact systemd .service names for owner inspection/restart. Use only for explicitly selected services on the connector host. Empty disables service control; restart requires a fresh 60-second Telegram confirmation.
